adjustments: Language attributes use explicit dcterms:language metadata on nodes, avoiding invalid @language assertions on rdf:value wrappers.
Plural ERNIE collection wrappers alias @nest; their singular keys keep the TIB property IRIs.
Creators and polygon vertices use ordered @list containers.
Scalar attrs/value objects coerce rdf:value through scoped contexts rather than coercing the containing node.
Related-item value aliases @nest with a non-propagating scoped context, retaining its metadata on the related-item node without changing descendant literals.
Name-identifier objects remain nodes with identifier literals and scheme attributes, rather than incorrectly coercing the object to an IRI.
